raw:
Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent misinterpreted the task’s temporal requirement. Instead of checking whether board members held C-suite roles at the time they joined Apple’s board, the agent concluded based on whether they had ever held C-suite positions in their careers. This conflation of “ever held” vs. “held at time of joining” led to incorrectly classifying Wanda Austin, Ronald D. Sugar, and Susan L. Wagner as having C-suite roles when they joined, which directly caused the wrong final answer.
